# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_settings_reference.py from the Config fields and this
template. Do not edit docs/settings.md by hand: edit
tools/templates/settings_reference.md and run `make docs-settings`. -->

Every setting lilbee has, and every surface that can change it. A setting's
environment variable is `LILBEE_` plus its name in upper case, except for the
[environment-only variables](#environment-only-variables) at the end, which are
not settings and are named individually.

## The five surfaces

A setting is one field of lilbee's configuration. Five surfaces read or write it, and they do not all expose the same set, so each table below carries one column per surface.

| Surface | How you set a value | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Environment | `LILBEE_<SETTING>=value` | Every setting in the tables below, plus the environment-only variables at the end. Applies to the process you launch |
| Config file | `setting = value` in `.lilbee/config.toml` | Every setting in the tables below. Persists |
| TUI | the `/settings` screen, or `/set <setting> <value>` | See the TUI column. Persists |
| MCP | `lilbee_settings_set({"setting": value})` | See the MCP column. Persists |
| HTTP | `PATCH /api/config` with `{"setting": value}` | See the HTTP column. Persists |

There is no general `lilbee set` command. From a shell, set the environment variable or edit `config.toml`. The two CLI commands that do write a setting are named in the CLI column. The top-level `--data-dir`, `--model`, `--log-level` and `--json` flags override their setting for one invocation and do not persist.

## Reading the surface columns

**TUI.** `yes` is editable in place. `picker` opens a model chooser instead of a text field. `read-only` is shown but not editable. `no` is not on the screen.

**MCP.** `yes` is settable with `lilbee_settings_set` and listed by `lilbee_settings_list`. `write-only` is settable but never readable: the API keys carry a `write_only` flag, so `lilbee_settings_get` refuses them and `lilbee_settings_list` skips them. `no` means the environment or the config file is the only way in.

**HTTP.** The same, with two exceptions. `role API` means `PUT /api/models/<role>` sets it, not `PATCH /api/config`. `refused` means the server rejects the write, because applying it rebuilds the model provider under concurrent requests.

**CLI.** The command that writes this setting, or `no`.

## Three rules that apply only over MCP

**Some settings change the tool list, and the change needs a reconnect.** `wiki`, `memory_enabled` and `mcp_sessions_enabled` decide which tools register. The gate runs once, when the server is built, and MCP sends no `tools/list_changed` notification from here. So `lilbee_settings_set({"wiki": true})` succeeds and persists, and the `lilbee_wiki_*` tools still do not appear until the client reconnects. Ask the user to restart the MCP server. `lilbee_wiki_status` and `lilbee_wiki_wipe` register either way, so a caller can always read the wiki's state and can always delete pages an earlier build wrote.

**Turning a feature on does not run it.** Setting `wiki` generates no pages. Build them with `lilbee_wiki_index`, then `lilbee_wiki_generate(slug)` for one page on demand, or `lilbee_wiki_build` for the whole corpus, which spends about one LLM call per source document. Set `wiki_auto_update` to regenerate touched pages after each sync.

**Some settings invalidate the index.** The settings marked **Reindex** below change how documents are split or embedded. `lilbee_settings_set` answers with `reindex_required: true`, and search stays wrong until `lilbee_sync(force_rebuild=true)` finishes.

## Models

| Setting | Environment | Type | Default | TUI | MCP | HTTP | CLI | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chat_model` | `LILBEE_CHAT_MODEL` | `str` | *(empty)* | picker | yes | role API | no | LLM used for chat generation (vision and reranking are separate slots). |
| `embedding_model` | `LILBEE_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `str` | *(empty)* | picker | yes | role API | `lilbee use-embedder REF` | Model used to embed document chunks. |
| `reranker_model` | `LILBEE_RERANKER_MODEL` | `str` | *(empty)* | picker | yes | role API | no | Cross-encoder model for result reranking. |
| `reranker_prompt` | `LILBEE_RERANKER_PROMPT` | `str` | *(empty)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Relevance prompt for LLM rerankers (blank uses the built-in template). |
| `reranker_type` | `LILBEE_RERANKER_TYPE` | `RerankerType` | `auto` | yes | yes | yes | no | Reranker serving mode: auto (detect cross-encoder vs LLM by model), cross_encoder, or llm. One of `auto`, `cross_encoder`, `llm`. |
| `vision_model` | `LILBEE_VISION_MODEL` | `str` | *(empty)* | picker | yes | role API | no | Vision model for scanned PDF OCR (empty = disabled; Tesseract only). |

## Retrieval

| Setting | Environment | Type | Default | TUI | MCP | HTTP | CLI | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adaptive_fusion` | `LILBEE_ADAPTIVE_FUSION` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Scale the BM25 weight per query by vector-arm confidence, not a fixed value. |
| `adaptive_fusion_margin` | `LILBEE_ADAPTIVE_FUSION_MARGIN` | `float` | `0.15` | yes | yes | yes | no | Vector-similarity margin at which adaptive fusion fully silences the BM25 arm. |
| `adaptive_threshold` | `LILBEE_ADAPTIVE_THRESHOLD` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Widen the distance cutoff when too few results pass (vector-only fallback path). |
| `adaptive_threshold_step` | `LILBEE_ADAPTIVE_THRESHOLD_STEP` | `float` | `0.2` | yes | yes | yes | no | Step size for adaptive relevance-score relaxation when initial recall is empty. |
| `ann_index_threshold` | `LILBEE_ANN_INDEX_THRESHOLD` | `int` | `50000` | yes | yes | yes | no | Chunk count to start building an ANN vector index (0 = always flat search). |
| `candidate_multiplier` | `LILBEE_CANDIDATE_MULTIPLIER` | `int` | `3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Candidate-pool multiplier over top_k before reranking. |
| `concept_boost_weight` | `LILBEE_CONCEPT_BOOST_WEIGHT` | `float` | `0.3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum boost (0-1) the concept graph can add to a chunk's relevance. |
| `concept_graph` | `LILBEE_CONCEPT_GRAPH` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Boost retrieval scores for chunks that share concepts with the query. |
| `concept_max_per_chunk` | `LILBEE_CONCEPT_MAX_PER_CHUNK` | `int` | `5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum concept tags stored per chunk (caps graph density). |
| `contextual_enrichment` | `LILBEE_CONTEXTUAL_ENRICHMENT` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | LLM context sentence per chunk embedding (slow ingest; rebuild to apply). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `diversity_max_per_source` | `LILBEE_DIVERSITY_MAX_PER_SOURCE` | `int` | `5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum chunks accepted from any one source (caps source dominance). |
| `embed_titles` | `LILBEE_EMBED_TITLES` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Prefix document titles to chunk embeddings (rebuild to apply). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `expansion_guardrails` | `LILBEE_EXPANSION_GUARDRAILS` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Drop expansions that diverge from the original intent. |
| `expansion_short_query_tokens` | `LILBEE_EXPANSION_SHORT_QUERY_TOKENS` | `int` | `2` | yes | yes | yes | no | Queries at or below this token count skip expansion (saves a model call). |
| `expansion_similarity_threshold` | `LILBEE_EXPANSION_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Minimum cosine similarity an expansion must keep with the original query. |
| `filter_structural_chunks` | `LILBEE_FILTER_STRUCTURAL_CHUNKS` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Drop tables-of-contents and classification-banner cover pages from results. |
| `fts_language` | `LILBEE_FTS_LANGUAGE` | `str` | `English` | yes | yes | yes | no | Stemmer/stop-word language for BM25 indexes (rebuild to apply). One of `Arabic`, `Danish`, `Dutch`, `English`, `Finnish`, `French`, `German`, `Greek`, `Hungarian`, `Italian`, `Norwegian`, `Portuguese`, `Romanian`, `Russian`, `Spanish`, `Swedish`, `Tamil`, `Turkish`. **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `history_rewrite` | `LILBEE_HISTORY_REWRITE` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Rewrite follow-ups into standalone retrieval queries using chat history. |
| `hyde` | `LILBEE_HYDE` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Use HyDE (hypothetical answer expansion) to broaden retrieval. |
| `hyde_weight` | `LILBEE_HYDE_WEIGHT` | `float` | `0.7` | yes | yes | yes | no | Weight on the HyDE-generated query vector when blending with the original. |
| `intent_llm` | `LILBEE_INTENT_LLM` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Classify count questions with the chat model when the fast patterns miss (covers phrasing variants and other languages; adds one short LLM call to those turns). |
| `intent_routing` | `LILBEE_INTENT_ROUTING` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Route document-name lookups to exact retrieval, count questions to a scan. |
| `lexical_fusion_weight` | `LILBEE_LEXICAL_FUSION_WEIGHT` | `float` | `1.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | BM25 arm weight in fusion (1.0 = equal to vector; lower to favor dense). |
| `max_context_sources` | `LILBEE_MAX_CONTEXT_SOURCES` | `int` | `8` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum unique sources contributing chunks to a single answer. |
| `max_distance` | `LILBEE_MAX_DISTANCE` | `float` | `0.75` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum vector distance for retrieval matches (lower = stricter). |
| `min_relevance_score` | `LILBEE_MIN_RELEVANCE_SCORE` | `float` | `0.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Minimum RRF relevance score for hybrid search results (0.0 = no filter). |
| `mmr_lambda` | `LILBEE_MMR_LAMBDA` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | MMR lambda balancing relevance vs diversity (0 = max diversity, 1 = max relevance). |
| `neighbor_expansion` | `LILBEE_NEIGHBOR_EXPANSION` | `int` | `0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Adjacent chunks merged into each retrieved passage per side (0 = off). |
| `query_expansion_count` | `LILBEE_QUERY_EXPANSION_COUNT` | `int` | `3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Number of paraphrase expansions per query (0 disables expansion). |
| `rerank_blend` | `LILBEE_RERANK_BLEND` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Blend reranker scores with retrieval fusion (off = pure reranker order). |
| `rerank_candidates` | `LILBEE_RERANK_CANDIDATES` | `int` | `60` | yes | yes | yes | no | Candidate pool size for reranking. |
| `rerank_min_score` | `LILBEE_RERANK_MIN_SCORE` | `float|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Drop candidates whose raw reranker score is below this (unset = off). |
| `temporal_filtering` | `LILBEE_TEMPORAL_FILTERING` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Detect temporal queries and bias retrieval toward recent chunks. |
| `title_search` | `LILBEE_TITLE_SEARCH` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Match queries against document titles as a third hybrid-search arm. |
| `title_search_weight` | `LILBEE_TITLE_SEARCH_WEIGHT` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Title arm weight in rank fusion (1.0 = equal voice with the other arms). |
| `top_k` | `LILBEE_TOP_K` | `int` | `12` | yes | yes | yes | no | Number of chunks returned by search. |

## Generation

| Setting | Environment | Type | Default | TUI | MCP | HTTP | CLI | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chat_compaction` | `LILBEE_CHAT_COMPACTION` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Off (default): when a chat outgrows the model's context window the oldest turns are dropped. They stay on screen but the model stops seeing them, and the context chip by the prompt shows the window filling. Costs nothing. On: those turns are condensed into a short summary the model keeps reading, so it still knows roughly what was said. That costs one extra model call each time it fires, pausing the reply for a few seconds on a GPU and considerably longer on a CPU-only machine. Worth turning on if your hardware is quick. |
| `chat_mode` | `LILBEE_CHAT_MODE` | `str` | `search` | yes | yes | yes | no | search runs every chat turn through document retrieval; chat skips it. One of `search`, `chat`. |
| `chat_n_ctx_target` | `LILBEE_CHAT_N_CTX_TARGET` | `int` | *(scales with host RAM)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Working context the dynamic picker aims for. Fits a RAG turn with reasoning headroom; raise for long-document chat. |
| `completions_reasoning` | `LILBEE_COMPLETIONS_REASONING` | `ReasoningMode` | `separate` | yes | yes | yes | no | How /v1/chat/completions presents thinking: separate reasoning_content field, inline thinking as plain content text, or off (ask the model not to think). One of `separate`, `inline`, `off`. |
| `cpu_moe` | `LILBEE_CPU_MOE` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Keep a mixture-of-experts model's expert weights in system memory so it fits a smaller GPU. No effect on dense models. |
| `embed_replicas` | `LILBEE_EMBED_REPLICAS` | `int` | `0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Embedding servers in parallel (0 = auto, one per GPU; positive pins the count). |
| `fast_model_downloads` | `LILBEE_FAST_MODEL_DOWNLOADS` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Warning: Hugging Face states this mode uses all available bandwidth and CPU cores, and buffers far more of the download in memory. Faster on a fast connection, at the cost of everything else running on the machine. Leave it off unless the machine can spare that. Requires a restart to take effect. |
| `flash_attention` | `LILBEE_FLASH_ATTENTION` | `bool|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Flash attention. Empty (auto) enables it; disable for backends or models where it misbehaves. Resolves the V-cache padding warning on models with uneven per-layer V dims. |
| `general_system_prompt` | `LILBEE_GENERAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | yes | yes | yes | no | System prompt sent when there are no documents to ground the answer. |
| `gpu_devices` | `LILBEE_GPU_DEVICES` | `str|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Restrict llama.cpp to specific GPU indexes on dual-GPU machines (e.g. NVIDIA dGPU + integrated). Comma-separated, like '0' or '0,1'. Applies to Vulkan, CUDA, and ROCm. Requires a restart to take effect. |
| `gpu_memory_fraction` | `LILBEE_GPU_MEMORY_FRACTION` | `float` | `0.75` | yes | yes | yes | no | Fraction of GPU memory the model is allowed to claim (0.1-1.0). |
| `kv_cache_type` | `LILBEE_KV_CACHE_TYPE` | `KvCacheType` | `q8_0` | yes | yes | yes | no | KV cache element type. q8_0 / q4_0 halve or quarter cache memory but require flash attention to be enabled. One of `f16`, `f32`, `q8_0`, `q4_0`. |
| `main_gpu` | `LILBEE_MAIN_GPU` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Primary GPU index for llama.cpp when multiple devices are visible. Empty = let llama.cpp pick (index 0). Set this together with gpu_devices to pin inference to a specific card. Requires a restart to take effect. |
| `max_reasoning_chars` | `LILBEE_MAX_REASONING_CHARS` | `int` | `64000` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum reasoning characters before lilbee forces the model to answer (0 = unlimited; per-model overrides apply on top). |
| `max_tokens` | `LILBEE_MAX_TOKENS` | `int|null` | `4096` | yes | yes | yes | no | Hard cap on generated tokens per response (blank = no cap). |
| `mcp_sessions_enabled` | `LILBEE_MCP_SESSIONS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Off (default): the session tools are not offered over MCP, and a connected agent cannot create or read agent sessions. On: an agent can keep its own saved conversations, separate from yours. Most agent hosts already track their own history, and the tools cost context on every request, so this stays off unless you want an agent owning conversations. **Reconnect MCP** for the tool list to change. |
| `messages_reasoning` | `LILBEE_MESSAGES_REASONING` | `ReasoningMode` | `separate` | yes | yes | yes | no | How /v1/messages presents thinking: separate thinking block, inline thinking as plain answer text, or off (ask the model not to think). One of `separate`, `inline`, `off`. |
| `model_keep_alive` | `LILBEE_MODEL_KEEP_ALIVE` | `int` | `300` | yes | yes | yes | no | Seconds the loaded model stays warm between calls (0 = unload immediately). |
| `n_cpu_moe` | `LILBEE_N_CPU_MOE` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Offload only the first N layers' experts to system memory. Takes precedence over the offload-everything setting; smaller N stays faster. |
| `n_gpu_layers` | `LILBEE_N_GPU_LAYERS` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Layers to offload to GPU. Empty = all (recommended), 0 = CPU only, positive int = partial offload for tight VRAM. |
| `num_ctx` | `LILBEE_NUM_CTX` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Context window size in tokens. Leave empty to size automatically (aims for chat_n_ctx_target, ceiling at num_ctx_max or training_ctx). |
| `num_ctx_max` | `LILBEE_NUM_CTX_MAX` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Explicit ceiling for the dynamic context picker. Leave empty to use the model's training_ctx from GGUF metadata as the only ceiling. Set to cap below training_ctx (saves KV memory). |
| `rag_system_prompt` | `LILBEE_RAG_SYSTEM_PROMPT` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | yes | yes | yes | no | System prompt sent when answering with retrieved context. |
| `repeat_penalty` | `LILBEE_REPEAT_PENALTY` | `float|null` | `1.1` | yes | yes | yes | no | Penalty for repeating tokens. |
| `seed` | `LILBEE_SEED` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Random seed for reproducible output. |
| `sessions_enabled` | `LILBEE_SESSIONS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | On (default): conversations are saved automatically, and you can list, resume, rename, and delete them from the Sessions drawer (ctrl+o), the Sessions tab, and the /sessions command. Off: nothing is written to disk, the ctrl+o binding leaves the footer, and opening the Sessions view shows a notice that sessions are turned off. Turn it off if you would rather your chats not persist. Covers the TUI, the HTTP server, and the CLI; agent sessions have their own setting. |
| `system_memory_reserve_gb` | `LILBEE_SYSTEM_MEMORY_RESERVE_GB` | `float` | `4.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | RAM held back for the OS in GiB when serving from system memory (no discrete GPU). Capped at a quarter of total RAM either way. |
| `temperature` | `LILBEE_TEMPERATURE` | `float|null` | `0.1` | yes | yes | yes | no | Sampling temperature (higher = more creative). |
| `top_k_sampling` | `LILBEE_TOP_K_SAMPLING` | `int|null` | `40` | yes | yes | yes | no | Top-K sampling: number of tokens to consider. |
| `top_p` | `LILBEE_TOP_P` | `float|null` | `0.9` | yes | yes | yes | no | Nucleus sampling cutoff probability. |
| `usable_vram_fraction` | `LILBEE_USABLE_VRAM_FRACTION` | `float` | `0.9` | yes | yes | yes | no | Share of a GPU placement may fill, leaving room for fragmentation and driver overhead (0.5-1.0). Raise it if a model that should fit is being refused; lower it if loads fail near the top of the card. |
| `vision_replicas` | `LILBEE_VISION_REPLICAS` | `int` | `0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Vision OCR servers in parallel (0 = auto, one per GPU; positive pins the count). |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto_sync` | `LILBEE_AUTO_SYNC` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Run a sync before `lilbee ask` (disable on large static corpora). |
| `batch_extraction` | `LILBEE_BATCH_EXTRACTION` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Coalesce concurrent extractions into one xberg batch call. |
| `batch_extraction_size` | `LILBEE_BATCH_EXTRACTION_SIZE` | `int` | `8` | yes | yes | yes | no | Max files per extract_batch call when batch extraction is on. |
| `chunk_overlap` | `LILBEE_CHUNK_OVERLAP` | `int` | `100` | yes | yes | yes | no | Tokens of overlap between adjacent chunks (preserves context across boundaries). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `chunk_size` | `LILBEE_CHUNK_SIZE` | `int` | `512` | yes | yes | yes | no | Document chunk size in tokens (changes invalidate the index). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `enable_ocr` | `LILBEE_ENABLE_OCR` | `bool|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Vision OCR for scanned PDFs (empty = auto-detect from vision_model). |
| `entity_extraction` | `LILBEE_ENTITY_EXTRACTION` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Extract typed entities automatically at sync (schema induced on first run). |
| `ingest_processes` | `LILBEE_INGEST_PROCESSES` | `int` | `0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Ingest worker processes, one GPU each (0 = auto, one per card). Used once the corpus is big enough to pay for them; 1 keeps ingest in this process. |
| `ingest_workers` | `LILBEE_INGEST_WORKERS` | `int` | `0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Workers for discovering and hashing files (0 = auto, all available cores). |
| `layout_detection` | `LILBEE_LAYOUT_DETECTION` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Layout-aware PDF extraction: reading order plus header/footer stripping (changes invalidate the index). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `ocr_language` | `LILBEE_OCR_LANGUAGE` | `list` | `eng` | yes | yes | yes | no | Tesseract OCR languages when no vision model is set; '+'-join, e.g. eng+deu. |
| `ocr_timeout` | `LILBEE_OCR_TIMEOUT` | `float` | `300.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Per-page timeout in seconds for vision OCR (0 = no limit). |
| `semantic_chunking` | `LILBEE_SEMANTIC_CHUNKING` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Opt-in topic-aware chunker (default off; may fragment numbered procedures). |
| `table_extraction` | `LILBEE_TABLE_EXTRACTION` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Index each extracted table as its own chunk (changes invalidate the index). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `table_model` | `LILBEE_TABLE_MODEL` | `TableModel` | `slanet_auto` | yes | yes | yes | no | Table structure model used when layout detection is on: slanet_auto (docling-parity default), other slanet variants, tatr, or disabled (changes invalidate the index). One of `disabled`, `tatr`, `slanet_auto`, `slanet_plus`, `slanet_wired`, `slanet_wireless`. **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `tesseract_timeout` | `LILBEE_TESSERACT_TIMEOUT` | `float` | `60.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Per-page Tesseract timeout in seconds (used when no vision model is set). |
| `token_sizing` | `LILBEE_TOKEN_SIZING` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Size chunks by real embedder tokens, not chars (changes invalidate the index). **Reindex** with `lilbee rebuild` after changing. |
| `topic_threshold` | `LILBEE_TOPIC_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.75` | yes | yes | yes | no | Topic-boundary similarity threshold, 0.0-1.0, used when semantic chunking is on. |
| `vision_load_budget_s` | `LILBEE_VISION_LOAD_BUDGET_S` | `float` | `300.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Wall-clock seconds reserved for the vision worker to load the model. Total PDF-OCR budget = load_budget + ocr_timeout * pages. |
| `vision_ocr_concurrency` | `LILBEE_VISION_OCR_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `4` | yes | yes | yes | no | Pages OCR'd concurrently per vision server; each slot adds KV cache memory. |
| `vision_ocr_max_tokens` | `LILBEE_VISION_OCR_MAX_TOKENS` | `int` | `4096` | yes | yes | yes | no | Hard cap on tokens generated per OCR page (bounds runaway repetition loops); raising it lengthens page generation, so give ocr_timeout headroom. |
| `worker_pool_eager_start` | `LILBEE_WORKER_POOL_EAGER_START` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Spawn every configured role server at TUI startup instead of on first use. Trades cold-start time per role for first-call latency. |

## Wiki

| Setting | Environment | Type | Default | TUI | MCP | HTTP | CLI | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wiki` | `LILBEE_WIKI` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Enable the wiki layer (cited concept and entity pages). GPU-heavy: a build spends one LLM call per source document, so a large library takes hours. Enabling this generates nothing on its own: you wikify explicitly, or turn on wiki_auto_update. **Reconnect MCP** for the tool list to change. |
| `wiki_auto_update` | `LILBEE_WIKI_AUTO_UPDATE` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Regenerate touched wiki pages after each sync (off: wikify explicitly). |
| `wiki_batch_min_chunks` | `LILBEE_WIKI_BATCH_MIN_CHUNKS` | `int` | `3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Minimum chunks a source must contribute before its batched call includes concept curation. Sources below the floor skip the concept-curation instruction; sources with zero entities AND below the floor are skipped entirely. |
| `wiki_clusterer` | `LILBEE_WIKI_CLUSTERER` | `ClustererBackend` | `embedding` | yes | yes | yes | no | Synthesis clusterer backend (embedding or concepts). One of `embedding`, `concepts`. |
| `wiki_clusterer_k` | `LILBEE_WIKI_CLUSTERER_K` | `int` | `0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Mutual-kNN neighborhood size for the clusterer (0 = auto). |
| `wiki_dir` | `LILBEE_WIKI_DIR` | `str` | `wiki` | read-only | no | no | no | Directory under data_root where wiki pages live (set via env / config.toml only). |
| `wiki_drift_threshold` | `LILBEE_WIKI_DRIFT_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Max fraction of changed lines before regeneration requires review. |
| `wiki_embedding_faithfulness_threshold` | `LILBEE_WIKI_EMBEDDING_FAITHFULNESS_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Minimum cosine similarity (0-1) between a generated page and the mean of its source chunk vectors before publishing. Pages below the threshold route to drafts/. |
| `wiki_entity_batch_prompt` | `LILBEE_WIKI_ENTITY_BATCH_PROMPT` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Prompt for the per-source batched call. Must keep {source}, {entity_list}, {chunks_text}, and {concept_instruction}. |
| `wiki_entity_min_mentions` | `LILBEE_WIKI_ENTITY_MIN_MENTIONS` | `int` | `3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Minimum chunk mentions before an entity or concept gets its own page. |
| `wiki_entity_mode` | `LILBEE_WIKI_ENTITY_MODE` | `WikiEntityMode` | `ner_entities` | yes | yes | yes | no | Entity extraction strategy. ner_entities (typed spaCy NER) is the only implemented mode; the other values fall back to it with a warning. One of `ner_entities`, `ner_concepts_plus_llm_types`, `llm_tagged`. |
| `wiki_entity_page_prompt` | `LILBEE_WIKI_ENTITY_PAGE_PROMPT` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Prompt for a single page generated on demand from one subject's chunks across every source naming it. Must keep {topic}, {source_list}, and {chunks_text}. |
| `wiki_extract_concepts` | `LILBEE_WIKI_EXTRACT_CONCEPTS` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Whether the per-source batched call asks the LLM to curate concept pages alongside the pre-extracted entity list. |
| `wiki_ingest_update_cap` | `LILBEE_WIKI_INGEST_UPDATE_CAP` | `int` | `20` | yes | yes | yes | no | Touched-page cap for auto-update after sync. Beyond this count, run `lilbee wiki update` manually. |
| `wiki_prune_raw` | `LILBEE_WIKI_PRUNE_RAW` | `bool` | `false` | yes | yes | yes | no | Delete raw chunks after summarizing into the wiki. |
| `wiki_stale_citation_threshold` | `LILBEE_WIKI_STALE_CITATION_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Fraction of stale citations before a page is flagged by wiki prune. |
| `wiki_stub_max_chunk_refs` | `LILBEE_WIKI_STUB_MAX_CHUNK_REFS` | `int` | `50` | yes | yes | yes | no | How many source chunks a page kept for lazy generation draws on. Caps the browse index's size; already more than one page's context budget admits, so raising it rarely changes what a page says. |
| `wiki_summary_max_tokens` | `LILBEE_WIKI_SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS` | `int` | `2048` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum tokens generated per wiki page. |
| `wiki_synthesis_prompt` | `LILBEE_WIKI_SYNTHESIS_PROMPT` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Prompt for cross-source synthesis pages. Must keep {topic}, {source_list}, and {chunks_text}. |
| `wiki_temperature` | `LILBEE_WIKI_TEMPERATURE` | `float` | `0.1` | yes | yes | yes | no | Temperature used for wiki page synthesis (low = stay close to sources). |

## Crawling

| Setting | Environment | Type | Default | TUI | MCP | HTTP | CLI | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crawl_browser_extra_args` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_BROWSER_EXTRA_ARGS` | `list` | `--disable-dev-shm-usage, --disable-gpu` | yes | yes | yes | no | Browser mode: extra Chromium launch flags, one per line. Defaults trim shared-memory and GPU use. |
| `crawl_browser_recycle_pages` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_BROWSER_RECYCLE_PAGES` | `int` | `50` | yes | yes | yes | no | Browser mode: recycle the Chromium process every N pages to cap memory growth on long crawls (0 = never recycle). |
| `crawl_concurrent_requests` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS` | `int` | `3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Concurrent in-flight URLs within one crawl. |
| `crawl_convert_workers` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_CONVERT_WORKERS` | `int` | `2` | yes | yes | yes | no | Crawled pages converted to markdown on worker threads at once, so a crawl does not block request handling; 0 converts on the event loop. |
| `crawl_exclude_patterns` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` | `list` | *(built-in list)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Regex patterns that skip URLs at link-discovery time during recursive crawls. One per line. |
| `crawl_max_delay_range` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_MAX_DELAY_RANGE` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Random jitter (seconds) added on top of mean delay. |
| `crawl_max_depth` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_MAX_DEPTH` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Optional recursion-depth cap (blank = no cap; per-crawl values win). |
| `crawl_max_pages` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_MAX_PAGES` | `int|null` | *(none)* | yes | yes | yes | no | Optional global cap on total pages per crawl (blank = no cap). |
| `crawl_mean_delay` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_MEAN_DELAY` | `float` | `0.5` | yes | yes | yes | no | Seconds between in-flight requests within a single crawl. |
| `crawl_render_mode` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_RENDER_MODE` | `CrawlRenderMode` | `http` | yes | yes | yes | no | How crawls fetch pages. http = lightweight, no browser (default, best for static and server-rendered sites). browser = Chromium with JavaScript enabled for client-rendered sites, at much higher memory cost. One of `http`, `browser`. |
| `crawl_retry_base_delay_max` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MAX` | `float` | `3.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Maximum base-delay (seconds) on rate-limit responses. |
| `crawl_retry_base_delay_min` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MIN` | `float` | `1.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Minimum base-delay (seconds) on rate-limit responses. |
| `crawl_retry_max_attempts` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `3` | yes | yes | yes | no | Retry count per URL when a rate-limit code comes back. |
| `crawl_retry_max_backoff` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_RETRY_MAX_BACKOFF` | `float` | `30.0` | yes | yes | yes | no | Upper bound on any single backoff wait (seconds). |
| `crawl_retry_on_rate_limit` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_RETRY_ON_RATE_LIMIT` | `bool` | `true` | yes | yes | yes | no | Enable per-domain backoff and retries on HTTP 429/503. |
| `crawl_safety_max_pages` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_SAFETY_MAX_PAGES` | `int` | `5000` | yes | yes | yes | no | Default page bound for an unbounded crawl, so a hostile site cannot exhaust the disk. An explicit max-pages overrides it; raise this to crawl larger sites unbounded. |
| `crawl_sync_interval` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_SYNC_INTERVAL` | `int` | `30` | yes | yes | yes | no | Seconds between periodic re-syncs during a crawl (0 = sync only at end). |
| `crawl_timeout` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_TIMEOUT` | `int` | `30` | yes | yes | yes | no | Per-page fetch timeout in seconds. |

## File and environment only

These settings have no runtime write path. Set them with a `LILBEE_*` environment variable, or in `config.toml`, before lilbee starts.

| Setting | Environment | Type | Default | TUI | MCP | HTTP | CLI | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_http_placement` | `LILBEE_ALLOW_HTTP_PLACEMENT` | `bool` | `false` | no | no | no | no | Let PUT and DELETE /api/placement change model placement over HTTP. Off by default because applying placement restarts the moved roles, which is unsafe with concurrent clients. Turn it on only for a deployment you alone use. |
| `concept_allowed_ent_types` | `LILBEE_CONCEPT_ALLOWED_ENT_TYPES` | `list` | *(built-in list)* | no | no | no | no | spaCy NER labels the wiki entity extractor keeps. It drops everything else (QUANTITY, CARDINAL, DATE, and so on) before aggregation. |
| `cors_origin_regex` | `LILBEE_CORS_ORIGIN_REGEX` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | no | no | no | no | Regular expression matching browser origins the HTTP server accepts. |
| `cors_origins` | `LILBEE_CORS_ORIGINS` | `list` | *(empty)* | no | no | no | no | Extra browser origins the HTTP server accepts, in addition to cors_origin_regex. |
| `crawl_max_concurrent` | `LILBEE_CRAWL_MAX_CONCURRENT` | `int` | `0` | no | no | no | no | Pages fetched in parallel during a crawl. 0 = unlimited; default = CPU count. |
| `data_dir` | `LILBEE_DATA_DIR` | `str` | *(computed)* | no | no | no | no | Directory holding the database. Defaults to data_root/data. |
| `data_root` | `LILBEE_DATA_ROOT` | `str` | *(computed)* | no | no | no | no | Root directory for this library. Resolved at start from LILBEE_DATA, then a .lilbee/ directory walked up from the working directory, then the platform default. Every other path below hangs off it. |
| `embed_batch_sequences` | `LILBEE_EMBED_BATCH_SEQUENCES` | `int` | `64` | no | yes | yes | no | Passages packed into one embed request. Larger batches keep a GPU's continuous-batching slots full. The engine re-splits to its physical batch, so raising this helps only up to the server's --batch. |
| `embedding_dim` | `LILBEE_EMBEDDING_DIM` | `int` | `768` | no | no | no | no | Vector width the index is built with. The embedding model sets it; change it only to match a model lilbee cannot introspect. |
| `expansion_skip_gap` | `LILBEE_EXPANSION_SKIP_GAP` | `float` | `0.15` | no | no | no | no | Minimum relative BM25 gap between the top two hits that skips query expansion. |
| `expansion_skip_threshold` | `LILBEE_EXPANSION_SKIP_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.8` | no | no | no | no | Saturating BM25 confidence above which query expansion is skipped. 0.8 corresponds to a raw BM25 score of 20. |
| `hyde_prompt` | `LILBEE_HYDE_PROMPT` | `str` | *(built-in text)* | no | no | no | no | Prompt template HyDE uses to write the hypothetical answer. Must contain {question}. |
| `ignore_dirs` | `LILBEE_IGNORE_DIRS` | `list` | *(built-in list)* | no | no | no | no | Directory names ingest never walks (.git, node_modules, and similar). Use a .lilbeeignore file for per-library patterns. |
| `ingest_max_inflight` | `LILBEE_INGEST_MAX_INFLIGHT` | `int` | `0` | no | yes | yes | no | Files allowed in their compute phase at once during ingest. 0 = auto, scaled to the detected embed fleet. Sizes the extract and embed fan-out, not the planning pass. |
| `json_mode` | `LILBEE_JSON_MODE` | `bool` | `false` | no | no | no | no | Emit structured JSON from CLI commands. The --json flag sets it for one invocation. |
| `lancedb_dir` | `LILBEE_LANCEDB_DIR` | `str` | *(computed)* | no | no | no | no | Directory holding the LanceDB vector tables. Defaults to data_root/data/lancedb. |
| `linked_roots` | `LILBEE_LINKED_ROOTS` | `dict` | *(empty)* | no | write-only | write-only | no | External source roots that `add` registered, as label -> absolute path. `add` and `remove` maintain it; do not edit it by hand. |
| `markdown_rendering` | `LILBEE_MARKDOWN_RENDERING` | `bool` | `true` | no | no | no | no | Render chat replies as Markdown in the TUI. Off draws plain text, which is faster. |
| `max_embed_chars` | `LILBEE_MAX_EMBED_CHARS` | `int` | `2000` | no | no | no | no | Maximum characters sent to the embedding model per chunk. Longer text is cut. |
| `models_dir` | `LILBEE_MODELS_DIR` | `str` | *(computed)* | no | no | no | no | Directory holding downloaded model files. Shared across libraries, so a model pulled for one is available to all. |
| `placement` | `LILBEE_PLACEMENT` | `str|null` | *(none)* | no | write-only | write-only | `lilbee placement set` | Manual multi-GPU placement spec. It fully replaces the automatic planner: each active role pins to the listed device indices. Edit it with the placement commands, not the settings list. Empty uses the VRAM-aware planner. |
| `server_host` | `LILBEE_SERVER_HOST` | `str` | `127.0.0.1` | no | no | no | no | Address `lilbee serve` binds. Loopback by default; set 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from the network. |
| `server_port` | `LILBEE_SERVER_PORT` | `int` | `0` | no | no | no | no | Port `lilbee serve` binds. 0 picks a free port and prints it. |

## Environment-only variables

These are not configuration fields, so they have no row above and `config.toml` does not carry them. The code reads them straight from the environment.

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `LILBEE_AGENT_ID` | Owner namespace for an MCP agent's memories and sessions. An explicit `agent_id` tool argument wins over it |
| `LILBEE_CPU_QUOTA` | CPU concurrency cap. Defaults to half the available cores; a non-positive or unparseable value falls back to that default |
| `LILBEE_DATA` | Data directory for this library, the same value as `data_root`. The older and more common spelling; `--data-dir` overrides it |
| `LILBEE_ENGINE_DIR` | Directory holding the llama-server engine binaries. Set it to run against an engine build other than the bundled one |
| `LILBEE_EXCLUSIVE_SCOPE` | A directory that at most one server may serve at a time, for a plugin's shared root |
| `LILBEE_INGEST_CONCURRENCY` | Extraction-admission mode: `static` (the default), `adaptive-conservative`, or `adaptive-aggressive` |
| `LILBEE_INGEST_MAX_WORKERS` | Files per embed replica kept in flight during ingest |
| `LILBEE_INGEST_TRACE` | Set to any value to trace each document through ingest |
| `LILBEE_INGEST_TRACE_FILE` | File the ingest trace is written to |
| `LILBEE_LOG_LEVEL` | Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR. `--log-level` overrides it |
| `LILBEE_NO_SPLASH` | Set to any value to suppress the startup splash animation |
| `LILBEE_OCR_FORCE` | Force vision OCR on pages that already carry a text layer. It has no effect on those pages today; set `vlm_fallback` instead |
| `LILBEE_TOKEN` | Auth token for the HTTP server. The launchers set it to the live session token so no literal token is written to a config file on disk |
